json-tools.title: JSON Tools
json-tools.intro: Everything you need to work with JSON - format, validate, compare, convert, transform and generate. All tools run entirely in your browser with no file upload required.

faqs.question: How do I format JSON online?
faqs.answer: Use our free JSON Formatter - paste your JSON, choose indent style (2 spaces, 4 spaces, or tab), and get formatted output instantly.

faqs.question: How do I validate JSON?
faqs.answer: Our JSON Validator checks syntax and reports the exact line and column of any error. It supports both JSON and JSONL formats.

faqs.question: What is JSONPath?
faqs.answer: JSONPath is a query language for JSON, like XPath for XML. Use our JSONPath Tester to run expressions like $.users[*].email against any JSON document.

faqs.question: How do I convert JPG to WebP for free?
faqs.answer: Use our free JPG to WebP converter - drag and drop your JPG, download the WebP instantly. No upload to any server, no account required.

faqs.answer: We support 118 conversion combinations including JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, SVG, ICO, TIFF, HEIC, JXL, PSD, TGA, and PDF.

faqs.question: Does converting images reduce quality?
faqs.answer: Lossless conversions (PNG to WebP lossless, PNG to BMP) preserve every pixel. Lossy conversions (JPG, WebP lossy) have a quality setting - use 80-85% for minimal visible quality loss.

faqs.question: Are my images uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No - all image conversion happens locally in your browser. Your images never leave your device.

faqs.question: Can I also resize, crop or compress images here?
faqs.answer: Yes - the free Image Resizer, Image Cropper and Image Compressor are listed in the Image Editing Tools section above. Like the converters, they run entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: How do I merge PDF files for free?

faqs.question: How do I compress a PDF?

faqs.question: How do I password-protect a PDF?
faqs.answer: Our PDF Protect tool adds AES-256 encryption. Enter a user password, upload your PDF, and download the protected version instantly.

faqs.question: Is it safe to use online PDF tools?
faqs.answer: With BeYourTools, your PDF files never leave your device. All processing happens locally in your browser - nothing is uploaded to any server.

sections.heading: 1. Overview
sections.html:
BeYourTools ("we", "us", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your personal data.

Key fact: All tool processing (JSON, image conversion, PDF operations) happens entirely in your browser. Files, JSON data, and text you paste into tools are never transmitted to our servers.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
sections.html:
2.1 Automatically Collected Data

When you visit BeYourTools, our hosting provider and analytics tools may automatically collect:

  • IP address (anonymised)
  • Browser type and version
  • Operating system
  • Pages visited and time spent
  • Referring website
  • Device type (desktop, mobile, tablet)

This data is collected in aggregate and cannot be used to identify you individually.

2.2 Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies for: site preferences (theme settings), analytics, and advertising. See our Cookie Policy for full details.

2.3 Information You Voluntarily Provide

If you contact us via email, we collect your email address and message content solely to respond to your inquiry.

  • Support: Responding to contact form messages

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties.

about.title: About BeYourTools
about.intro: I'm Be, and I build BeYourTools: fast, private, browser-based tools for everyone. Zero file uploads, zero sign-ups, zero paywalls.

who.heading: Who's behind BeYourTools
who.name: Be, Founder & Editor
who.bio: Hi, I'm Be. I started BeYourTools because I was tired of "free" online tools that demanded an account, a subscription, or an upload of my private files to somebody's server. So I built the alternative myself: every tool on this site runs entirely in your browser, and I write the guides on the blog from real testing. If something breaks or you want a new tool, you're talking directly to the person who built it. That's me.

why.heading: Why I built this
why.html:
Daily tasks like converting images, compressing PDFs, or formatting JSON should be fast and simple. Yet most sites force you to create accounts, pay subscriptions, or upload private files to remote servers.

I created BeYourTools to remove these hurdles. I believe helpful tools should be free, fast, and private by default. Using modern browser technology, WebAssembly, and local processing, every tool runs right on your device. Your documents, photos, code, and finances never leave your hands.

what.heading: What We Build
what.introHtml: BeYourTools provides over 320+ free tools across seven categories, all built to run instantly right in your browser:

categories.label: JSON & Developer Tools
categories.desc: Format, validate, and compare JSON data in your browser. Decode JWT tokens and convert JSON to CSV, YAML, Python, and SQL with zero server uploads.

categories.label: Image Converter Suite
categories.desc: Convert images between JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, SVG, ICO, and PDF. Convert multiple files at once, preview changes instantly, and download as a ZIP file.

categories.label: PDF Document Suite
categories.desc: Merge, split, and compress PDF files right on your device. Add passwords, rotate pages, or extract text and images without uploading files to any server.

categories.label: Video Tools Suite
categories.desc: Compress and trim videos right in your browser. Convert MP4, WebM, and MKV files, create animated GIFs, and grab clean video frames.

categories.label: Audio Tools Suite
categories.desc: Cut, join, and compress audio files with ease. Boost volume, convert formats like MP3 and WAV, or record sound right inside your web browser.

categories.label: QR & Barcode Suite
categories.desc: Make custom QR codes with logos, build WiFi QR codes, scan codes with your camera, and create retail barcodes like UPC-A and Code 128.

categories.label: Financial & Business Calculators
categories.desc: Calculate loan payments, payoff dates, interest, and profit margins. Plan your budget, compare debts, and estimate your take-home paycheck.

tech.heading: How the technology works (client-side architecture)
tech.html:
Most online tools upload your files to remote servers, run scripts, and send files back. That causes delays and puts your privacy at risk.

I built BeYourTools to work differently: everything runs directly on your device:

  • In-memory processing: tools run inside your browser memory using local Web Workers and WebAssembly.
  • Zero external storage: I never store your files, text, or results. When you close the tab, everything is gone.
  • Fast performance: processing files locally uses your device's power, so you never wait for slow uploads.

items.title: Private by Default
items.body: Your files and text stay on your device. We never send your documents, photos, or code to any cloud server.

items.title: Free to Use
items.body: All core tools are 100% free. Enjoy full access without paywalls, subscriptions, daily limits, or hidden costs.

items.title: Fast and Simple
items.body: No account needed. Just open any tool, drop in your files, and download your results in seconds.

items.title: Works Everywhere
items.body: Use our tools on phones, tablets, and laptops. Enjoy clean layouts with light and dark mode support.

advertising.heading: Sustainable & Transparent Advertising
advertising.html:
BeYourTools is completely free to use thanks to clean, simple ads. Ad revenue pays for our hosting, fast global network, and ongoing tool updates.

We follow clear ethical advertising rules:

  • No deceptive "fake download" buttons or misleading advertisements.
  • No intrusive modal popups, audio auto-play ads, or screen-blocking overlays.
  • Full compliance with Google AdSense quality and placement guidelines.

To learn more about our advertising practices and privacy safeguards, please review our Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy.

engineering.heading: Engineering Standards & Formula Verification
engineering.html:
We build every tool to follow strict web standards and exact math formulas:

  • Data Formats: Our JSON tools follow official RFC 8259 rules. They format and check code so it works across all modern apps.
  • PDF Documents: Our PDF tools follow ISO 32000 rules. Your fonts, lines, and layout stay sharp and clean on any device.
  • Finance Math: Every calculator uses proven math formulas. We test our loan, interest, and tax math against standard banking rules.
  • Media Processing: Audio and video tools run locally using modern browser WebAssembly. Your media transforms fast without network lag.

editorial.intro: I write the guides on this site to give you clear, honest, and practical help, tested by me, in the tools themselves. No fake filler text, no spammy marketing content.

faqs.question: How quickly does the BeYourTools team respond?
faqs.answer: We aim to reply to all messages within 2 to 3 business days. Security reports and broken tool notices receive top priority.

faqs.question: How can I submit an effective bug report?
faqs.answer: Share the tool name, your browser brand and version, and any error message shown on your screen. Describing the steps to reproduce the issue helps us fix bugs much faster.

faqs.question: Can I suggest a new browser tool or format?
faqs.answer: Yes, we welcome tool ideas. Tell us the input formats you want to convert, your desired output format, and how the tool will help your workflow.

faqs.question: Does BeYourTools log or store my contact message?
faqs.answer: We only use your name and email to answer your inquiry. We never sell your contact details or use them for marketing newsletters without your consent.

faqs.question: What should I do if a tool fails to process my file?
faqs.answer: First, check that your file is not password protected or corrupted. Try refreshing your browser tab or disabling browser extensions that block WebAssembly scripts.

faqs.question: Why does BeYourTools run tools directly in the browser?
faqs.answer: Processing files locally ensures your photos, PDFs, and private documents never leave your computer. This gives you maximum speed, zero upload wait times, and complete data privacy.

faqs.question: How do I report a security issue or privacy concern?
faqs.answer: If you notice a security flaw or unexpected data behavior, email us directly with the subject Security Report. We investigate all security notices within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Can I use BeYourTools without an internet connection?
faqs.answer: Most tools require an internet connection to load the initial page assets. Once loaded into your browser tab, tools process your files locally in device memory without needing ongoing network access.
